notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Attempt to draw a card.
The card draw is replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, causing you instead to discard Dakmor Salvage, then mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Skola Grovedancer triggers, attempting to cause you to draw a card due to Lich.
Repeat from step 2.
